composition: Purposive role coverage, not population proportions. One freelancer, one mentor, one indifferent employed developer per run. Community data excludes mentors and has41unknown contexts; not suitable for joint-market panel quotas.
source_limits: Provided edited interview records, not independently verified verbatim transcripts. Every simulation output is SYNTHETIC. A future cross-check is against held-out supplied records, not a fresh real-user validation.
